notes: Implemented Phase 4 of Follow-Up Change Requests Plan (CR-FU-02: Multi-Finger Trackpad Gestures via PointerEvent). Extended MultiTouchHandler.js with PointerEvent support alongside existing TouchEvent path. Key implementation: extracted shared gesture functions (startGesture, processGesture, endGesture) used by both input paths; PointerEvent state via activePointers Map; pointerType guard prevents double-firing on hybrid devices; setPointerCapture on both pointers for robust tracking; window blur/visibilitychange handlers for gesture cleanup on tab switch; preventDefault called AFTER startGesture succeeds. Added touch-action: none to previewCanvas CSS. Addressed 3 world-review warnings: (1) TouchEvent preventDefault moved after startGesture check for consistency with PointerEvent path. (2) setPointerCapture applied to both pointers, not just the second. (3) Global window blur/visibilitychange listeners added for gesture state cleanup. All 33 MultiTouchHandler tests pass, full suite passes (1 pre-existing SaliencyDebugOverlay failure unrelated).
